title: LeNet-5

paper.title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement LeNet-5: compose learned local filters, tanh nonlinearities and spatial averaging into a digit classifier. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use mnist; required output: [N,1,28,28] -> [N,10] logits. Evaluate accuracy (maximize). 5x5 convolution average pooling tanh and bounded MNIST training. Required ablation: Replace average pooling with max pooling while preserving the training schedule.

dataset.name: mnist
dataset.description: 5x5 convolution average pooling tanh and bounded MNIST training
dataset.split_policy: Disjoint train/validation/test examples; fit preprocessing using training data only.
